KNIFEHERO-ALL_YOU_CAN_EAT.title: All You Can Eat
KNIFEHERO-ALL_YOU_CAN_EAT.description: Exhaust all knives and shivs in your hand. Gain 3 HP for each. Any healing beyond your max HP becomes Block instead. Exhaust.
KNIFEHERO-FAITH.title: Faith
KNIFEHERO-FAITH.description: Deal {Damage} damage. The next time you draw Faith, it deals 10 damage.
KNIFEHERO-QUEER.title: Queer
KNIFEHERO-QUEER.description: Innate. Eternal. Unplayable. Whenever a Strike or Defend you own is Exhausted, Queer it instead: it returns to your deck with a queer rider (it lays Poison when played).
KNIFEHERO-KUNAI.title: Throwing Shiv
KNIFEHERO-KUNAI.description: Deal 1 damage. If this is in your hand at the end of your turn, deal 3 damage to ALL enemies and Exhaust.
KNIFEHERO-GAY_BLADE_STRIKE.title: Strike
KNIFEHERO-GAY_BLADE_DEFEND.title: Defend
KNIFEHERO-FANCY_FOOTWORK.title: Switch Blade
KNIFEHERO-FANCY_FOOTWORK.description: Deal {Damage} damage and forge a Top Chop. If this is in your hand at the end of your turn, gain {Block} Block and forge a Bottom Blade instead. Either way, a Strike or Defend in your discard pile becomes a Switch Blade. Exhaust.
KNIFEHERO-LABRYS.title: Labrys
KNIFEHERO-LABRYS.description: Retain. While this is in your hand, block the next instance of damage you would take, gain that much attack, then discard this. Deal {Damage} damage.
KNIFEHERO-RAINBOW_STRIKE.title: Rainbow Strike
KNIFEHERO-RAINBOW_STRIKE.description: Deal 2 damage for every Flag you have.
KNIFEHERO-VANISH.title: Vanish
KNIFEHERO-PRIDE_WAS_A_RIOT.title: Pride was a Riot
KNIFEHERO-PRIDE_WAS_A_RIOT.description: Remove all of the target's Block, then deal {Damage} damage.
KNIFEHERO-KNIFE_WHIP.title: Knife Whip
KNIFEHERO-KNIFE_WHIP.description: Deal {Damage} damage. Each point of damage dealt to Block becomes a Shiv in your discard pile, and reduces this card's damage by that much.
KNIFEHERO-THROWING_KNIFE.title: Throwing Knife
KNIFEHERO-THROWING_KNIFE.description: Deal {Damage} damage. If this deals HP damage, Exhaust it. If it doesn't, return it to your hand.
KNIFEHERO-THE_CLOSET.title: The Closet
KNIFEHERO-THE_CLOSET.description: Gain 3 Stealth and become Closeted: each turn, discard a card to prevent the next damage you take (an empty hand breaks the closet for a Dazed). Playing an Attack blows your cover — lose all Stealth.
KNIFEHERO-THE_DISCOURSE.title: The Discourse
KNIFEHERO-THE_DISCOURSE.description: If this is in your hand at the end of your turn, gain 1 less energy next turn. Exhaust.
KNIFEHERO-EXTREMELY_ONLINE.title: Extremely Online
KNIFEHERO-EXTREMELY_ONLINE.description: Gain 2 energy. Gain 2 energy at the start of each turn. Shuffle a Discourse into your draw pile.
At the start of each turn, put a copy of a Blade from your deck into your hand. It gains Exhaust and Ethereal.
KNIFEHERO-RECITE.title: Recite
KNIFEHERO-ANNOTATE.title: Annotate
KNIFEHERO-OPEN_BOOK.title: Open Book
KNIFEHERO-MARGINALIA.title: Marginalia
KNIFEHERO-MARGINALIA.description: Whenever you play a Book or a Power, gain 1 Lesson.
KNIFEHERO-POLYMATH.title: Polymath
KNIFEHERO-POLYMATH.description: At the start of each turn, gain 1 Lesson.
KNIFEHERO-GALVANISM.title: Galvanism
KNIFEHERO-SOLITUDE.title: Solitude
KNIFEHERO-WRETCHEDNESS.title: Wretchedness
KNIFEHERO-FIRE_STOLEN.title: Fire, Stolen
KNIFEHERO-RECOMBINANT.title: Recombinant
KNIFEHERO-RECOMBINANT.description: Deal {Damage} damage once for each Power you have.
KNIFEHERO-QUOTE_AT_LENGTH.title: Quote at Length
KNIFEHERO-QUOTE_AT_LENGTH.description: Deal damage equal to your Lessons.
KNIFEHERO-DONT_LOOK_AWAY.title: Don't Look Away
KNIFEHERO-DONT_LOOK_AWAY.description: Return a random card from your Exhaust pile to your hand. Lose 2 HP.
KNIFEHERO-READ_THE_REMAINDER.title: Read the Remainder
KNIFEHERO-READ_THE_REMAINDER.description: Heal HP equal to the number of cards in your Exhaust pile.
KNIFEHERO-STONEWALL.title: Stonewall
KNIFEHERO-STONEWALL.description: Gain {Block} Block. Deal {Damage} damage for each Pride card you have played this combat.
KNIFEHERO-PIN.title: Pin
KNIFEHERO-PIN.description: Deal {Damage} damage. If this damages the enemy, apply 2 Weak and 2 Vulnerable.
KNIFEHERO-POISON_COATING.title: Poison Coating
KNIFEHERO-POISON_COATING.description: This turn, the Shivs you play apply 3 Poison.
KNIFEHERO-EXPLOSIVE_TIP.title: Explosive Tip
KNIFEHERO-EXPLOSIVE_TIP.description: This turn, the Shivs you play hit ALL enemies and Exhaust.
KNIFEHERO-SUPERFAN_OF_KNIVES.title: Superfan of Knives
KNIFEHERO-SUPERFAN_OF_KNIVES.description: Deal {Damage} damage to ALL enemies. Add a Shiv to your hand for each enemy. Your Shivs hit all enemies this turn. Exhaust.
KNIFEHERO-VEXING_MEMORY.title: Vexing Memory
KNIFEHERO-VEXING_MEMORY.description: Unplayable. Ethereal. If this is in your hand at the end of your turn, gain 1 Grief, then lose HP equal to your Grief.
KNIFEHERO-THROBBING_HEART.title: Throbbing Heart
KNIFEHERO-THROBBING_HEART.description: Retain. Eternal. Each turn you hold this, gain 1 Grief and lose HP equal to your Grief. Requires 2 Grief and 2 Lessons: spend them and mend into a Mended Heart (+2 max HP). If not mended within 3 turns, it festers.
KNIFEHERO-FESTERING_WOUND.title: Festering Wound
KNIFEHERO-FESTERING_WOUND.description: Unplayable. While this is in your hand, your attacks deal 1 more damage. At the end of each turn it is in your hand, lose 2 HP.
KNIFEHERO-WALLOW.title: Wallow
KNIFEHERO-WALLOW.description: Gain Block equal to your Grief.
KNIFEHERO-KEENING.title: Keening
KNIFEHERO-KEENING.description: Exhaust your hand. Gain 1 Grief for each card exhausted, then deal damage equal to twice your Grief to ALL enemies.
KNIFEHERO-MENDED_HEART.title: Mended Heart
KNIFEHERO-MENDED_HEART.description: Deal {Damage} damage. "Nothing is ever completely broken."
KNIFEHERO-BECOME_WHO_YOU_ARE.title: Become Who You Are
KNIFEHERO-BECOME_WHO_YOU_ARE.description: At the start of each turn, gain Strength equal to your number of Powers and gain 1 Lesson. "I was benevolent and good; misery made me a fiend."
KNIFEHERO-TOP_CHOP.title: Top Chop
KNIFEHERO-TOP_CHOP.description: Retain. Exhaust. Gain Vigor equal to twice this blade's forge level.
KNIFEHERO-BOTTOM_BLADE.title: Bottom Blade
KNIFEHERO-FEINT.title: Feint
KNIFEHERO-HONEYPOT.title: Honeypot
KNIFEHERO-HONEYPOT.description: Gain Thorns equal to your Heat, plus 2.
KNIFEHERO-SMOKE_BOMB.title: Smoke Bomb
KNIFEHERO-SHADOW_DODGE.title: Shadow Dodge
KNIFEHERO-GO_TO_GROUND.title: Go to Ground
KNIFEHERO-LOOK_WHAT_I_FOUND_DOWN_HERE.ti: Look What I Found Down Here
KNIFEHERO-LOOK_WHAT_I_FOUND_DOWN_HERE.de: Gain {Block} Block. Turn all of your Stealth into Shivs.
KNIFEHERO-DAY_OF_INVISIBILITY.title: Day of Invisibility
KNIFEHERO-DAY_OF_INVISIBILITY.descriptio: Your attacks do not break your Stealth this turn. Exhaust.
KNIFEHERO-PICKPOCKET.title: Pickpocket
KNIFEHERO-PICKPOCKET.description: The first time you deal damage each turn, gain a Shiv.
KNIFEHERO-DEAD_NAME.title: Dead Name
KNIFEHERO-DEAD_NAME.description: Whenever you would gain Heat, add a Dazed to your discard pile instead.
KNIFEHERO-SILENT_PRIDE.title: Silent Pride
KNIFEHERO-SILENT_PRIDE.description: Retain. While this is in your hand, gain {Block} Block whenever you discard a card. Deal {Damage} damage and apply 1 Weak. Put a Shiv in your discard pile and reduce this card's damage by 1.
KNIFEHERO-IRONCLAD_PRIDE.title: Ironclad Pride
KNIFEHERO-IRONCLAD_PRIDE.description: Retain. While this is in your hand, deal {Burn} damage to a random enemy whenever you Exhaust a card. Deal {Damage} damage and apply {Vuln} Vulnerable.
KNIFEHERO-WATCHER_PRIDE.title: Watcher Pride
KNIFEHERO-WATCHER_PRIDE.description: Retain. While this is in your hand, draw 2 cards and discard 1 at the start of your turn. Draw {Draw} cards.
KNIFEHERO-REGENT_PRIDE.title: Regent Pride
KNIFEHERO-REGENT_PRIDE.description: Retain. Can only be played by Exhausting another Pride card in your hand. At the start of each turn, deal 6 damage to an enemy and gain 6 Block.
KNIFEHERO-DYKE_PRIDE.title: Dyke Pride
KNIFEHERO-DYKE_PRIDE.description: Retain. While this is in your hand, the next time you would lose HP, prevent it and add that much damage to this card. Deal {Damage} damage.
KNIFEHERO-HEAD_EMPTY_NO_THOUGHTS.title: Head Empty, No Thoughts
KNIFEHERO-CHILL_TOUCH.title: Chill Touch
KNIFEHERO-FIRE.title: Fire
KNIFEHERO-FIRE.description: Deal {Damage} damage, plus your Heat. Gain 1 Heat.
KNIFEHERO-BACKSTAB.title: Backstab
KNIFEHERO-BACKSTAB.description: Deal {Damage} damage, plus 2 for each Stealth you have.
KNIFEHERO-FINGER_GUNS.title: Finger Guns
KNIFEHERO-FINGER_GUNS.description: Retain. If this is in your hand at the end of your turn, deal {Damage} damage twice and gain 1 Heat. The next Attack you play this turn is played twice.
KNIFEHERO-BOTH_IS_GOOD.title: Both Is Good
KNIFEHERO-BOTH_IS_GOOD.description: The first Pride card you play each turn also triggers its end-of-turn effect.
